name: Weighted Palm
description: Strike with an open palm while gravity qi doubles its weight at the instant of contact with the chest.

name: Heavy Guard
description: Make the forearms heavy with gravity qi so a blow must push a great mass to move them.

name: Settling Step
description: Plant the foot with a pull of added weight so the user lands steady and ready to strike again.

name: Mass Fist
description: Throw a fist loaded with gravity so heavily that it hits like a dropped block of stone.

name: Heft Sense
description: Judge the weight of a thing or a person by feel to know how hard it will fall or push.

name: Low Ballast
description: Lower the centre of the body with gravity qi so that the user stands steadier and strikes harder.

name: Lumbering Stride
description: Stride forward with each foot falling like a weight so the ground grips the user at every pace.

name: Footfall Strike
description: Stamp the lead foot and drive a punch on the same beat so the weight of the step rides the blow.

name: Dragging Pace
description: Stamp near an opponent's foot and load its ankle with weight so its next step comes late.

name: Ponderous Guard
description: Drop the guard low and heavy so a rushing blow meets a mass that does not move.

name: Pinned Heel
description: Press the heel down with gravity qi so the stance cannot be swept or thrown.

name: Draw Palm
description: Hold a palm toward an opponent's arm and draw it toward the user along a line of pull.

name: Tug Step
description: Let a pull from a nearby fixed object carry the user a step toward it with no effort.

name: Pulling Strike
description: Draw the opponent forward by the shoulder and meet its stumble with a strike to the chest.

name: Gather Pull
description: Draw loose pebbles into a tight cluster with gravity and fling them as one hard shot.

name: Tether Mark
description: Tie a thread of pull to a foe's sleeve that tugs it back toward the user each time it retreats.

name: Slack Guard
description: Draw a blow's force toward the ground with a pull so it slides off the user's side.

name: Pull Reading
description: Feel the lines of pull around heavy objects and know where a mass of weight lies hidden.

name: Sinking Guard
description: Let a blow's force sink through the arms and legs into the ground with a pull of qi.

name: Elbow Plunge
description: Drop the elbow onto a lowered head or shoulder with the full weight of the body.

name: Settle Stance
description: Sink into a wide stance where gravity holds the feet and the legs bear any shove.

name: Braced Step
description: Slide one foot and plant it with weight so that the new stance is as firm as the last.

name: Burden Shift
description: Move the weight through the legs and back so each strike has the whole body behind it.

name: Rooted Press
description: Press both palms forward from a sunk stance so the push carries the user's whole mass.

name: Burden Strike
description: Strike with a fist that carries a burden of added weight onto the target's guard.

name: Bearing Frame
description: Brace the shoulders as a frame to bear a heavy load or a heavy blow without bowing.

name: Carrying Pace
description: Walk at a steady pace under a heavy load with qi spread to hold the weight lightly.

name: Pack Weight
description: Heap added weight on a foe's raised arm so it droops and the attack fails.

name: Lighten Load
description: Ease the pull on the user's own body and gear so the user moves quickly for a moment.

name: Shoulder Press
description: Lean the shoulder into the foe and let the user's full weight follow it through.

name: Weight Reading
description: Read how much a person or a pack is carrying by the sag of the ground beneath it.

name: Crushing Hold
description: Grip a limb and add weight to the grip until the joint can no longer be turned.

name: Plunging Fist
description: Drop a fist from a high guard and let gravity add its pull to the strike.

name: Slump Step
description: Fall forward into a low stance and let the drop carry the user in under a swing.

name: Plummet Guard
description: Sink suddenly beneath a blow so it passes overhead and the user lands in a ready crouch.

name: Heel Drop
description: Bring the heel down on a foe's foot or shin with a pull that doubles its weight.

name: Descent Sense
description: Judge by the sound of a fall how far and how hard a thing has dropped.

name: Rising Weight
description: Lift the body with a gathered pull and let it fall into the next blow with added force.

name: Gravity Drop
description: Lob a stone overhead and call down its weight so it strikes the foe much harder than thrown.
